description: Turn print-only on or off for a Preesy session. With print-only on, the files can be printed but not downloaded, which keeps documents safer on shared computers. Use the manage_token of that session from its create_print_session result earlier in the conversation. The manage_token is secret. An expired session returns status only.

manage_token.description: Secret returned by create_print_session. Keep it private. A label and PIN do not work here.

print_only.description: true turns print-only on (print, no download). false turns it off so the file can be downloaded.

name: set_print_only
title: Set print only
